_comment.clips_dir: Directory containing per-clip JSON metadata files and matching MP4 videos.
_comment.repo_dir: Target repository directory (contains app.py and where videos/ + CSV will be written).
_comment.videos_dir: Subdirectory name under repo_dir where MP4 files are staged for upload.
_comment.csv_out: Output CSV filename written under repo_dir (consumed by app.py).
_comment.glob_pattern: Glob pattern used to find clip metadata JSON files (default: clip*.json).
_comment.video_ext: File extension of the video files to copy alongside each JSON (default: .mp4).
_comment.file_name_pattern: Pattern to build video file name from JSON stem; placeholders {stem} and {ext} supported (default: {stem}).
_comment.field_mapping: Maps CSV output columns to source JSON keys. Use 'key:join:sep' syntax to join list values (e.g. hashtags:join:,). The 'state' column defaults to 'unprocessed' (app.py only uploads rows whose state is 'unprocessed' and flips it to 'processed' after a successful upload); 'video_id' stores the YouTube video ID after upload.
